# Zero Hero

> Zero-based budgeting app that helps users achieve financial freedom through debt payoff, budget tracking, and behavioral coaching.

## Overview

Zero Hero is a progressive web app (PWA) for personal finance management. It uses a zero-based budgeting methodology where every dollar gets a "job." The app includes AI-powered budget drafting, debt payoff strategies, transaction tracking, subscription management, and gamified achievements.

## Core Features

### Zero-Based Budgeting
- Monthly income allocation across expense categories
- Every dollar assigned a purpose (zero-based)
- AI-powered "Draft My Budget" feature using Gemini Flash
- Budget variance alerts and spending insights

### Debt Strategy Engine
- Snowball (smallest balance first) and Avalanche (highest interest first) methods
- Visual payoff timeline with freedom date projection
- "Work hours reclaimed" calculation based on hourly wage
- Extra payment suggestions for high-interest debt (>20% APR)

### Transaction Management
- Manual transaction logging with category assignment
- CSV import wizard with column mapping
- AI-powered category suggestions based on description
- 3-month spending averages by category

### Subscription Tracker
- Active subscription monitoring with billing cycle tracking
- Next billing date alerts
- Monthly/annual spend calculations
- Subscription-to-transaction matching

### Account Management
- Multiple account support (checking, savings, credit cards)
- Balance tracking per account
- Net worth calculation (assets minus debts)

### Household Management
- Multi-user household support
- Role-based access (owner, admin, member, viewer)
- Email-based invitation system with secure token hashing
- Shared financial data across household members

### Behavioral Coaching
- Supportive vocabulary system ("Detour" not "failure")
- Debt victory celebrations with confetti
- Level-up modals and achievement badges
- "Shadow cost" calculations (purchases in work hours)
- Surplus power tracking
- Freedom timeline widget

### Reports & Analytics
- Income reports
- Available-for-debt reports
- Net worth tracking
- Subscription spending reports
- Chart insights with trend analysis

### Gamification
- Achievement system with unlock conditions
- Getting Started checklist (6-step onboarding)
- Journey progress tracking
- Financial tips and educational content

### Data Management
- Local-first data storage (works offline)
- JSON backup export/import
- Account deletion with email verification
- Demo mode with sample data

### PWA Features
- Offline support with service worker
- Install prompt for home screen
- Pull-to-refresh on mobile
- Swipe navigation between pages

## Pages & Routes

### Public Pages
- `/` - Coming Soon / Landing page with waitlist signup
- `/landing` - Full marketing landing page with feature overview
- `/auth` - Authentication (login/signup modal)
- `/reset-password` - Password reset flow
- `/onboarding` - 4-step onboarding (hourly wage, primary debt, emergency fund goal, payoff timeline)
- `/pricing` - Subscription pricing plans
- `/checkout-success` - Post-payment confirmation
- `/privacy` - Privacy policy
- `/terms` - Terms of service
- `/legal` - Legal information
- `/help` - Help & support
- `/data-privacy` - Data privacy FAQ
- `/install` - PWA installation guide
- `/accept-invite/:token` - Household invitation acceptance

### Protected Pages (require layout/sidebar)
- `/dashboard` - Main command center with financial overview, debt targets, getting started checklist
- `/journey` - Financial freedom journey with step-by-step progress
- `/budgets` - Budget management with expense categories and income tracking
- `/debts` - Debt snowball/avalanche strategy with payoff simulation
- `/transactions` - Transaction log with filtering and CSV import
- `/subscriptions` - Active subscription tracker
- `/accounts` - Financial account management
- `/reports` - Report hub
- `/reports/income` - Income breakdown report
- `/reports/available` - Available-for-debt report
- `/reports/net-worth` - Net worth tracking report
- `/reports/subscriptions` - Subscription spending report
- `/achievements` - Unlocked achievements and badges
- `/learn` - Financial tips and educational content
- `/data` - Data management (backup, restore, clear, delete account)
- `/account` - Account settings and profile
- `/household` - Household management and invitations
- `/settings/connector` - Browser extension connector setup
- `/settings/release-kit` - Release kit and branding assets

### Admin Pages
- `/admin/login` - Admin authentication
- `/admin/waitlist` - Waitlist management dashboard

### Style Guides
- `/style-guide/icons` - Icon style reference
- `/style-guide/colors` - Color palette reference

## Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- **UI Components**: shadcn/ui (Radix primitives)
- **Animation**: Framer Motion
- **Charts**: Recharts
- **Backend**: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Edge Functions, RLS)
- **AI**: Lovable AI Gateway (Google Gemini Flash) for budget drafting and transaction categorization
- **Payments**: Stripe (checkout, subscriptions, webhooks)
- **Email**: Resend (transactional emails with React templates)
- **PWA**: vite-plugin-pwa with service worker

## API / Edge Functions

- `draft-budget` - AI-powered budget allocation suggestions
- `categorize-transaction` - AI transaction category prediction
- `faq-chat` - AI-powered FAQ chatbot
- `create-checkout` - Stripe checkout session creation
- `customer-portal` - Stripe customer portal access
- `check-subscription` - Subscription status verification
- `stripe-webhook` - Stripe event processing
- `subscribe-waitlist` - Waitlist email signup
- `unsubscribe-waitlist` - Waitlist removal
- `send-invitation` - Household invitation emails
- `send-deletion-code` - Account deletion verification
- `verify-deletion-code` - Deletion code validation
- `trial-reminder` - Trial expiration notification
- `test-subscription` - Subscription testing utility

## Data Model

### Core Tables
- `profiles` - User profiles linked to auth.users
- `expenses` - Budget expense categories with amounts
- `debts` - Debt accounts with balances, rates, minimums
- `transactions` - Financial transactions with categories
- `subscriptions` - Recurring subscription tracking
- `accounts` - Financial accounts (checking, savings, etc.)
- `households` - Multi-user household groups
- `household_members` - Household membership with roles
- `household_invitations` - Pending invitations
- `user_settings` - Per-user configuration
- `user_roles` - Role-based access control (admin, moderator, user)
- `waitlist_signups` - Pre-launch email signups
- `email_logs` - Transactional email tracking
